review_evidence: README identifies the repository as the GlaMS Formalising Mathematics in Lean course, with workshop sheets and homework in Formal2024 and supporting references.
The unit contains 127 primary Lean files of mathematical exercises, examples, and course formalizations rather than repository-only infrastructure.
Course/tutorial formal statements are in corpus scope; no source-local exclusion was established beyond globally tracked duplicate-role filtering.
summary: Retain formal-2024 as a substantial formal mathematics course corpus of workshop and homework formalizations.
